description: PeachState CoolChain — Georgia crop canopy/2m-air heat thresholds (°F), risk weights, GDD params, and Q10 spoilage params. Air-temp thresholds validated for GA humid subtropical climate (Employee 1 architecture review).

peach.name: Peach (Fort Valley / Peach County)
peach.notes: >95°F = rapid softening, brown rot; >100°F critical softening

pecan.name: Pecan (Albany / Dougherty County)
pecan.notes: Kernel fill is water-driven (UGA); heat + moisture co-driver required

watermelon.name: Watermelon (Crisp / Cordele area)
watermelon.notes: >95°F = hollow heart, reduced shelf life (heat-adjacent, mechanism is pollination)
